Renton Park Elementry school /ɹɜntɪn pɑːɹk ɜlɜmɜntri' skuːl/ is at 16828 128th Ave SE, Renton, WA 98058. It is in District 403 and is above avrenge (or at least the school district is) and is in King County. Its fifth graders go to Nelsen witch its eighth graders go to Linburg.
